headline: Recommended repealing three school policies and revising four others, including graduation requirements and admission at age 5.
summary: After a closed session on a legal memo about instruction, admission, and attendance policies, the committee unanimously recommended repealing three policies and revising four. Graduation requirement changes would take effect July 1, 2027.
decisions: Recommended unanimously that Policies 6141.52, 6141.4, and 6141.5 be repealed.
Recommended unanimously that Policy 6146 be revised effective July 1, 2027.
Recommended unanimously that Policy 6141.51 be revised and renamed.
Recommended unanimously that Policy 6172.6 be revised and renamed.
Recommended unanimously that Policy 5111 be revised and renamed.

decision_evidence.quote: Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be repealed: • Policy 6141.52 (Challenging Curriculum – Criteria for Identification of Eligible Grade 8, 9 Students) • Policy 6141.4 (Independent Study) • Policy 6141.5 (Advanced College Placement) Motion by: Nancy Hill Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli Unanimous

Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised effective July 1, 2027: • Policy 6146 (Graduation Requirements) Motion by: Nancy Hill Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli Unanimous

Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised and renamed: • Policy 6141.51 (Advanced Courses or Programs, Eligibility Criteria for Enrollment) Motion by: Nancy Hill Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli Unanimous

Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised and renamed: • Policy 6172.6 (External and Online Credit Options) Motion by: Nancy Hill Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli Unanimous

Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised and renamed: • Policy 5111: Admission to the Public Schools At or Before Age 5 Motion by: Nancy Hill Seconded by: Mario Ciccarini Unanimous

plain_text:
Policy Committee of the Hamden Board of Education 
 
ANNOUNCEMENT OF MEETING AND AGENDA 
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 17, 2026 
 
Public Session: 5:00 PM  
 
1. Call to order and roll call at 5:03pm 
Committee members: Nancy Hill, Chris Piscitelli, Mario Ciccarini 
Administration: Gary Highsmith, Erin Bailey, Brooke Stanziale, Heather Wachter 
 
2. Additions to the agenda 
No additions 
 
3. Public Comment on agenda items 
No comments 
 
4. Executive Session 
Move to Executive session at 5:09pm to discuss attorney-client privileged communication 
concerning policy review inviting Dori Antonetti, Gary Highsmith, Erin Bailey, Brooke Stanziale, 
Heather Wachter. 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Seconded by: Mario Ciccarini 
Unanimous 
 
a. Discussion of attorney-client privileged written memorandum (legal advice regarding 
instruction, admission, and attendance-related policies) for the following policies: 
INSTRUCTION--RELATED POLICIES 
• Policy 6146 (Graduation Requirements) 
• Policy 6141.4 and Regulation 6141.4 (Independent Study) 
• Policy 6141.51 (Advanced Courses or Programs, Eligibility Criteria for Enrollment) 
• Policy 6141.52 (Challenging Curriculum – Criteria for Identification of Eligible Grade 8, 9 
Students) 
• Policy 6141.5 (Advanced College Placement) 
• Policy 6172.6 (External and Online Credit Options) 
 
ADMISSION AND ATTENDANCE-RELATED POLICIES   
• Policy 5111: Admission to the Public Schools At or Before Age 5 
• Policy and Regulation 5113:  Attendance – Unexcused Absences 
• Policy and Regulation 6172.3: Home Schooling Statutory Authority  
 
 
5. Information and Possible Action Items 
Approval to recommend to the BOE various actions regarding the following policies: 
Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be repealed:  
• Policy 6141.52 (Challenging Curriculum – Criteria for Identification of Eligible Grade 8, 9 
Students) 
• Policy 6141.4 (Independent Study)
• Policy 6141.5 (Advanced College Placement) 
 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli 
Unanimous 
 
Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised effective July 
1, 2027:  
• Policy 6146 (Graduation Requirements) 
 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli 
Unanimous 
 
Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised and renamed:  
• Policy 6141.51 (Advanced Courses or Programs, Eligibility Criteria for Enrollment) 
 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli 
Unanimous 
 
 
Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised and renamed:  
• Policy 6172.6 (External and Online Credit Options) 
 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli 
Unanimous 
 
 
Committee motion to recommend to the BOE that the following policies be revised and renamed:  
• Policy 5111: Admission to the Public Schools At or Before Age 5 
 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Seconded by: Mario Ciccarini 
Unanimous 
 
 
b. Adjourn at 6:42pm 
 
Motion by: Nancy Hill 
Seconded by: Chris Piscitelli 
Unanimous
